text.tspan: Thou will show me the path of life
In Thy presence is fullness of joy.
In Thy presence is fullness of joy.
In Thy presence is fullness of joy.
At Thy right hand are pleasures evermore.
At Thy right hand are pleasures evermore.
At Thy right hand are pleasures,
At Thy right hand are pleasures,
At Thy right hand are pleasures evermore.
